name: forecast.results

list.description: List native forecast records for inclusive value dates and optional creation-time/account scope.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Inclusive valueDate start, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Inclusive valueDate end, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD.

parameters.name: record-from-time
parameters.description: Inclusive recordCreateTime start, HH:mm:ss or HHmmss; acquisition default 000000.

parameters.name: record-to-time
parameters.description: Inclusive recordCreateTime end, HH:mm:ss or HHmmss; acquisition default 235959.

parameters.name: account-alias
parameters.description: Exact native account alias; repeated values use OR. Commas and * are literal.

purpose: Read forecast records without calculating accuracy or joining other sources.

fields.name: recordCreateTime
fields.meaning: Native record clock time HHmmss; source timezone unknown.

fields.name: forecastBalance
fields.meaning: Native unscaled forecast amount; null, empty and zero remain distinct.

identity_description: Exact native nonempty string id; duplicate identities fail completeness.
limitations: GET /bankCashForecastRecordQuery.json with fixed tenant GUAPW3SG and restricted JSON-string query VO; six native amount bounds stay null.
Qualified offset width 5000 covered 1332 native records; maximum backend capacity is not established. Native total is result.count.
Both inclusive value-date bounds are required for acquisition. Full-day creation times default to 000000/235959; no source timezone or epoch conversion is inferred.
Complete native objects, unknown fields, nulls, precision and arrival order are preserved. No accuracy metric, cashflow, Get or related-source calls.
Bare offline List replays the saved acquisition. Explicit local selection cannot prove a changed native scope; strict reads reject unproved coverage.
Historical broad-scope backend count drift does not permit silent total correction, deduplication or incomplete cache publication.
